title: ReportPayload
description: Canonical JSON embedded in a signed one-page HTML report (`<script type="application/json" id="agent-receipt-report">`) by `agent-receipt report`. The Ed25519 signature is a SignatureDocument (docs/signature.schema.json) over the UTF-8 hex SHA-256 of the canonical form of this object (sorted object keys, no whitespace, array order kept). The signature document is not inside this object. `render(payload, signature)` writes the page and inserts the signature block (`id` `agent-receipt-report-sig`, or JSON `null` when unsigned) at a fixed place. `report verify` re-renders and requires the same bytes. A single missing trailing newline is ignored. Any other difference exits 2 with "page content does not match signed payload". Every string the page shows is a field here: verdict, banner, pills, agent, fingerprints, trust, signature status, title, UNREDACTED state, and the narrative. Exactly one payload block and exactly one signature block must sit outside HTML comments. Zero, a duplicate, a block inside a comment, or a payload that fails this schema exits 2. A detached `<report>.html.sig.json` is written when local keys load. renderVersion selects the HTML renderer. Every same-id file, and every file whose raw or embedded hash is the recorded sha256 or redactedSha256, must pass integrity. A file whose raw sha256 equals the recorded sha256 or redactedSha256 matches. When the payload records a fingerprint or originalFingerprint, that match requires a valid sidecar with that fingerprint, with or without --require-sig. When the payload is unsigned, a valid stray sidecar is ignored. An invalid sidecar fails. A session-package report (manifestSha256 set) may also match the redacted form, and a non-null originalFingerprint then requires that sidecar. originalSha256 is the pre-redaction hash when a package report knew it. A prune in the unsigned audit.jsonl is payload-only only when it is not timestamped before a capture, wrap, or watch event; the reason does not call that prune legitimate. A broken audit hash chain in the store being searched fails verify. A symlink fails verify. originalFingerprint, resignedBy, and signedBy are the manifest signer's claims when the report was built from a session package. This is not a certificate authority.

kind.description: Discriminator. Peers should reject other kinds.

version.description: Payload schema version. Not the CLI version and not renderVersion.

renderVersion.description: HTML renderer id. 1 is the v1.0.30 page. report verify selects the renderer by this integer and exits 2 for an unknown version. A later template adds a renderer and keeps this one.

cliVersion.description: agent-receipt version that wrote the report. Shown on the page.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the report was written. Shown on the page.

subject.description: receipt for one file. session for `report --session` or a `*.session` package.

session.description: Session id from the receipt or the package, or null. Shown on the page.

manifestSha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw session-manifest.json bytes, or null when the report is not a session package. Shown on the page.

exposure.description: redacted is the default pipeline. host is --include-host (secrets still masked). unredacted is --no-redact. Shown on the page.

verdict.description: FAILED wins, then UNTRUSTED, then UNSIGNED when the report itself has no signature, otherwise VERIFIED. A session root or any receipt that fails verification forces FAILED. An unsigned receipt does not by itself make a signed report UNSIGNED. report verify exits 0 only for VERIFIED with a valid signature and a matching page, or for an honestly UNSIGNED page without --require-sig.

title.description: Exact document title. agent-receipt writes "Agent Receipt report — " plus the verdict.

banner.description: Banner pixels. className is the verdict in lower case. signatureStatus is the exact line, such as "Report signature: present (trusted)" or "Report signature: absent (unsigned)".

unredacted.description: Null when exposure is redacted. Otherwise the visible UNREDACTED marker and its detail sentence. Hiding, commenting, or removing that marker changes the page bytes and fails verify.

verifyCommands.description: Exact offline commands shown on the page. Basenames, not absolute paths.

tree.description: Plain session tree shown on a session report, or null for a single receipt.

id.description: Receipt link id, or the canonical sha256 when the receipt has no id.

sha256.description: Canonical verify hash of the file the report was built from.

redactedSha256.description: Canonical hash of the default redacted body when it differs from sha256, otherwise null. A file whose raw sha256 equals this value is a byte match in a local-store report and in a session-package report, because the value is signed. When the payload records a fingerprint or originalFingerprint, that byte match requires a valid sidecar with the payload fingerprint (or originalFingerprint when fingerprint is null). When the payload is unsigned, a valid stray sidecar is ignored. An invalid sidecar fails. A local-store report does not accept a redact-then-hash stand-in. A session-package report (manifestSha256 set) may accept a candidate whose publishRedactedReceipt hash equals sha256 or this value, and a non-null originalFingerprint then requires a valid sidecar with that fingerprint. Every same-id candidate must still pass integrity.

originalSha256.description: Pre-redaction canonical hash of this receipt when a package report was built in a store that still had the file, otherwise null. Local-store reports leave this null. Verify treats it as a hash the index or audit log may still list, so deleting that original exits 2. It is not a second acceptance path that skips the sidecar check.

parent.description: Parent r- id or sha256, or null.

agent.description: Agent label shown on the page, or null.

verified.description: True when the receipt hash path matches. False forces the report verdict FAILED.

signature.description: Receipt sidecar status. invalid is a present sidecar that does not verify and forces verdict FAILED.

fingerprint.description: 64-hex fingerprint of the receipt sidecar, or null when unsigned.

trusted.description: True or false when an allowlist was active and the sidecar verified. Null when unsigned, invalid, or the allowlist was inactive.

originalFingerprint.description: Manifest signer's claim of the source sidecar fingerprint, or null. Not a second signature.

resignedBy.description: Manifest signer's claim of the key that re-signed a different key, or null.

signedBy.description: Manifest signer's claim of the exporter key that signed an unsigned source whose bytes changed, or null.

pills.description: Exact pill labels shown for this receipt.

timestamp.description: Timestamp line shown on the page.

branch.description: Branch line shown on the page.

head.description: HEAD line shown on the page.

range.description: Range as clean text, not raw Markdown.

message.description: Message line shown on the page.

summary.description: Summary as clean text, not a raw Markdown table.

files.description: Files touched, in receipt order. The page shows the first 50.

risks.description: Risk rows shown on the page. The page shows the first 50.
